title: Keyword Opportunity Map
summary: Find and validate a bounded set of keyword clusters, then map each supported opportunity to an existing or proposed page.

required_inputs.description: The site, business area, product, service, or topic whose opportunities should be evaluated.

scope.guidance: Expand no more than fifty candidate queries before finalist selection.

completion_without.limitation: The method cannot establish a bounded candidate search without query expansion evidence.

evidence_plan.fallback: Return an incomplete result with a missing-required-evidence stop reason.

scope.guidance: Measure only candidates whose metrics can change finalist selection or priority.

evidence_plan.condition: Use metrics only when qualitative demand evidence cannot distinguish or prioritize plausible candidates.

completion_without.limitation: Priorities remain qualitative and confidence must reflect the missing metric evidence.

evidence_plan.fallback: Rank with validated intent and fit evidence, and record that quantitative comparison was unavailable.

scope.guidance: Validate no more than five representative finalist queries against current result evidence.

completion_without.limitation: The method cannot validate intent, page type, or ambiguity without current result evidence.

evidence_plan.fallback: Return an incomplete result instead of presenting generated candidates as validated opportunities.

scope.guidance: Read only representative known pages needed to test ownership or overlap.

evidence_plan.condition: Use page content when the subject has an existing site and a finalist may overlap a known page role.

completion_without.limitation: The result cannot confirm page ownership or site-page overlap and must label affected mappings as provisional.

evidence_plan.fallback: Map the query cluster to an unresolved page decision and request a compatible page reader before implementation.

steps.instruction: Confirm the subject, market, audience, existing site context, and decision the opportunity map must support.
Inspect current runtime cost and authorization for the bounded expansion, metrics, and validation plan.
Expand a bounded candidate set from the confirmed subject without treating generated variants as validated demand.
Add current keyword metrics only where they can change candidate selection or priority.
Inspect current search results for finalists to validate intent, page type, and material ambiguity.
Cluster supported queries and map them to an existing page, a distinct proposed page, or a documented rejection.
Return the ranked opportunity set with evidence, differentiation, action, confidence, and constraints.

evidence_requirements: Every retained cluster is supported by observed queries and current result-page evidence.
Intent and recommended page type are interpretations linked to evidence records.
Existing-page assignments account for overlap with other known site pages.
Metrics record market, locale, freshness, and estimate limitations when available.
stop_conditions: Stop before paid expansion or metrics when current authorization is insufficient.
Stop or narrow the market when the subject or locale is too ambiguous to interpret results.
Return an empty completed opportunity set when no candidate survives validation.
completion_criteria: The candidate search and validation bounds are recorded.
Each included opportunity has a target, rationale, evidence, priority, confidence, and constraints.
Rejected finalists that materially explain the decision have a reason.
No more than ten opportunities are returned.

bounds.sample_guidance: Validate only the strongest bounded finalist set rather than collecting exhaustive keyword inventory.
